features.semantic_rationale: Calculates the average monthly charges per year of tenure, providing insight into the cost per year of service.
features.statistical_rationale: By averaging the monthly charges over the tenure, we can better understand the financial commitment a customer has made to the service.
features.business_interpretation: Customers with higher average monthly charges per year may be more valuable and less likely to churn, as they have a higher financial stake in the service.

features.transformation: sum(OnlineSecurity, OnlineBackup, DeviceProtection, TechSupport, StreamingTV, StreamingMovies)
features.semantic_rationale: Counts the number of add-on bundles a customer has, indicating their level of service customization.
features.statistical_rationale: A higher number of add-on bundles may correlate with a lower churn rate as customers are more satisfied with their service.
features.business_interpretation: Customers with more add-on bundles are likely to be more satisfied and less likely to churn, as they have access to a wider range of services.

features.semantic_rationale: Indicates if the customer is using a premium payment method, which may correlate with higher satisfaction and lower churn.
features.statistical_rationale: Premium payment methods may reduce friction in billing, leading to higher customer satisfaction and lower churn rates.
features.business_interpretation: Customers using a credit card for automatic payments are likely to be more satisfied and less likely to churn, as they have a convenient and reliable payment method.

features.semantic_rationale: Calculates the average total charges per year of tenure, providing insight into the total financial commitment over time.

features.business_interpretation: Customers with higher average total charges per year may be more valuable and less likely to churn, as they have a higher financial stake in the service.

features.semantic_rationale: Identifies if the customer has a contract longer than a month-to-month contract, which may indicate a higher level of commitment.
features.statistical_rationale: Longer contract durations may correlate with lower churn rates as customers are more committed to the service.
features.business_interpretation: Customers with a contract longer than a month-to-month contract are likely to be more committed and less likely to churn, as they have a longer-term agreement.
